text:
510 km. That is the stated range of the Corvane E3 delivery van on a single charge, according to Corvane Motors' Technical Specification Bulletin CM-E3/07, published 14 March 2025 at the Veldmarsh Commercial Vehicle Expo.

The figure was measured under a WLTC-style combined test cycle. The van carries a 92 kWh battery pack.

Ingrid Halvorsen-Pell, Head of Vehicle Certification at the Norveld Transport Standards Authority, is named in connection with the figure as the official overseeing certification of vehicles of this kind.

The bulletin is the first place the range appeared in print. No other performance numbers are covered here.

**What it means for the sector:** A 510 km stated range puts the E3 in a competitive position for operators weighing electric vans for long urban and regional routes. Fleet buyers will be watching how the combined-cycle number holds up in real-world loaded conditions, where results typically differ from test-cycle claims.
